scope: Original local signed state observation wrapper with separately pinned Ed25519 key, full proof/context binding and durable observer acceptance. No credential transcript or issuer/client/store logic changes; no application, wallet/file integration or deployment.

baselineReview.result: CodeRabbit reviewed the exact head without outstanding actionable findings; both app and PS profile jobs and Cloudflare preview passed. Bot review is not independent cryptographic validation.

runtime.sqlite: node:sqlite DatabaseSync, experimental flag, rollback journal, synchronous FULL
runtime.crypto: @noble/curves 2.4.0; frozen reference primitives, original ZFT-specific transcripts
runtime.stateSignature: Node v22.12.0 crypto Ed25519; noble 2.4.0 strict public-key decoding and separate verification in tests

verification.expected: Each temporary mutation must fail its named regression with ERR_ASSERTION; working source remains intact.

verification.result: Ephemeral issue, signed unspent observation, replacement and signed spent observation of original credential; exact replay rejects. Fresh in-memory Ed25519 key; public PS fixture keys; walletAuthenticated false.
Existing ephemeral lifecycle/recovery demonstration passes; walletAuthenticated remains false.
Python 3.12 hash-pinned environment reproduces unchanged exact fixture bytes; subgroup and pairing checks pass.
13 dependency versions, pinned artifacts and retained license notices pass; no dependencies added.
Passed with offline local runtimes; no live ZVM endpoint.

primitiveEvidence.vector: Ed25519 TEST 1, public seed and key, empty message, exact 64-byte signature. Node signing and verification, noble verification, changed-message rejection.
primitiveEvidence.composition: Noble independently verifies the exact framed bytes of a generated local receipt; this remains same-author composition and is not an external protocol vector or independent transcript review.

stateAcceptance.binding: Pinned full PS manifest hash and separate status key; protocol/realm/keyset, purpose, audience, challenge, wallet, h, lifetime and minimum sequence bind through the PS showing nonce and signed receipt. Receipt also binds exact request/showing hashes and verified nullifier.
stateAcceptance.time: Fixed 60-second interval, no clock skew tolerance; issuer snapshot timestamp and observer acceptance must fall inside it, and observer rejects future observations or sampled local clock rollback.
stateAcceptance.atomicity: Observer challenge/request persisted before submission; accepted receipt, consumed bit and highest sequence/time commit in one transaction. Two SIGKILL cases and separate-process race cover acceptance boundaries.
stateAcceptance.sequence: Reject below own accepted maximum. Actual earlier issuer database snapshot is rejected by an observer retaining a newer floor, but accepted by a fresh observer. No global consistency, issuer stop or rollback-resistant storage.
stateAcceptance.semantics: Receipt is a timestamped issuer assertion, not a spend reservation. A valid unspent observation can be accepted after a later spend within its interval; a fresh query sees the spend.
stateAcceptance.outage: Closed issuer and malformed unavailable-state receipts raise errors; no unspent fallback and no deletion of the pending request.
stateAcceptance.limits: Canonical exact schemas; 2048-byte manifest, 8192-byte request/receipt; at most 100 unconsumed/unexpired challenges. Historical row retention remains unbounded.

newNegativeControls: Omit audience from the PS showing challenge.
Accept a sequence below a newer remembered maximum.
Split sequence watermark and challenge/receipt commits.

documentationChecks.result: Passed relative file and Markdown heading-anchor checks; network links were not bulk checked.

unchanged: App, SDK, Worker and contract source
Brand assets, original untracked zft-logo and historical OG snapshots
Existing branches and worktree node_modules symlink

limitations: Same-author local research with public PS issuer test keys, plaintext databases and unqualified secret BigInt operations; unsuitable for real assets.
RFC primitive vector and Node/noble verification do not provide independent review of the composed state protocol or PS equations/transcripts.
State signatures prove what the pinned issuer reported; no issuer honesty, no supply/equivocation defense and no guaranteed unspent state after the snapshot.
Fresh observers, same/higher-sequence forks, restored observer backups and manipulated time/trust are not protected by the remembered sequence/time checks.
No trusted manifest distribution, key rotation/retirement, secure time source, HTTP transport, wallet authentication, image/file/vault adapter or hosted issuer.

SIGKILL is not power loss; prior page-limit/query_only tests do not qualify real disk, hardware or permission failures. Arbitrary IOERR, corruption, all boundaries, retention/availability and devices remain open.
Wallet bytes remain context only; walletAuthenticated false. Public showings expose linkable h and nullifier.
C2 local harness complete; C1/C3 partial; independent C4 review and C5/C6 integration/hosting remain open.
